notes: The prompt self-declares a kart racing game driven around a looped track for a set number of laps, so Racing leads and route-circuit is the shape it names outright. Circuit Racing is the preset: lap counting gives trigger-lap, the start/finish line gives startpoint-line and trigger-finish, and the barriers that keep the kart out of the void are barrier-guardrail, stated in the prompt rather than assumed. path-turnaround was dropped because a closed circuit needs no direction reversal to begin a lap. The prompt forbids questions, so I took the answered bright toy-kart look as the theme and kept the circuit compact; the vehicle controller, HUD, lap timing and result screen are mechanics and change nothing about the layout or the route.
